The Go implementation in `internal/pi` translates the established headless
Pi coding-agent stack from [earendil-works/pi](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi),
commit `d6af72e1857cfb10b41d8ff8e69f0d72b4cf6d31`.

Some modules use [sky-valley/pi](https://github.com/sky-valley/pi), commit
`e6b56e7223cfab707b21a0a19e0a9a2417ac960a`, as a translation reference.
Both projects are MIT licensed; their notices are retained beside this file.
